svg.desc: Higher temperature broadens the energy distribution and lowers its peak. At the same temperature, different molar masses have exactly the same energy distribution, shown as overlapping solid and dashed curves.
svg.title: Normalized Maxwell-Boltzmann translational kinetic-energy distributions
